searchStringsArray.title: Search terms
searchStringsArray.description: Search terms to query on Google Maps.

locationQuery.title: Location
locationQuery.description: Location appended to each search term.

language.title: Language
language.description: Google Maps interface language, for example en or de.

maxCrawledPlacesPerSearch.title: Max places per search
maxCrawledPlacesPerSearch.description: Maximum number of Google Maps place URLs to collect per search.

headless.title: Run browser headless
headless.description: Run Chromium without a visible browser window.

waitAfterSearch.title: Wait after search
waitAfterSearch.description: Milliseconds to wait after submitting a search.

waitAfterOpen.title: Wait after opening place
waitAfterOpen.description: Milliseconds to wait after opening a place detail page.

categoryFilterWords.title: Category filter words
categoryFilterWords.description: Keep only places whose category matches these words. Leave empty to keep all categories.

searchMatching.title: Search matching
searchMatching.description: Whether all or any category filter words must match.

placeMinimumStars.title: Minimum rating
placeMinimumStars.description: Minimum place rating, for example 4.5. Leave empty to disable.

skipClosedPlaces.title: Skip closed places
skipClosedPlaces.description: Discard places whose scraped open status contains closed.

scrapePlaceDetailPage.title: Scrape place detail page
scrapePlaceDetailPage.description: Disable to collect only lightweight fields and skip expensive detail extraction.

scrapeOpeningHours.title: Scrape opening hours
scrapeOpeningHours.description: Scrape weekly opening hours when detail scraping is enabled.

scrapeContacts.title: Scrape contacts
scrapeContacts.description: Scrape address, phone, and website when detail scraping is enabled.

scrapeDirectories.title: Scrape directories
scrapeDirectories.description: Reserved for compatibility. Current crawler does not export directory fields.

maxReviews.title: Max reviews
maxReviews.description: Maximum number of top reviews to scrape. Set to 0 to skip reviews.

maxImages.title: Max images
maxImages.description: Set to 0 to skip image extraction. Current crawler exports only the main image URL.

scrapeImageAuthors.title: Scrape image authors
scrapeImageAuthors.description: Reserved for compatibility. Current crawler does not export image author fields.
